explanation: The value is 0 at every D1 and D2 step, and at every GO step where the agent picks a2. It only turns on at a GO step where the agent picks a1 and the previous trial was rewarded after one or more unrewarded trials: about 10 when that reward ends a run of two or more losses, about 1-4 when it follows just one loss, about 4 on the next a1 GO if the reward repeats, then back to 0 during a steady run of rewards.
